title: Aether Reliquary visual replacement lane
summary: Retires rejected Bellroot prologue SVG/glyph sheets from production display and queues high-fidelity painted/rendered replacements while approved fallback art keeps /hq readable.
policies: Rejected/reference-only prologue sheets may remain in provenance records but must not lead runtime /hq visuals.
Replacement targets must point at the prologue-hifi-story-pack brief until approved runtime output exists.
Fallbacks must be approved manifest assets without style-rejected or reference-only tags.
Any new replacement runtime sheet needs prompt/provenance records, manifest metadata, frame dimensions, and visual validation.
The private RPG world stays in /hq and does not become public Homefront product positioning.
